explanation: Generated a five-point eta scan at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg using beam energy 6.53 GeV, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) mode. EXCLURAD preflight passed all five points. Exact cos(theta*)=+/-1 endpoints are known to fail the integration, so they were corrected to +/-0.999. The eta lookup table maid07-PPpi.tbl was not present in the working directory; obtain it before running the generated input.
